'''challenger HB, no EBO''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 16 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 HB challenger LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

HB. No EBO.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

You know what it is. Systems, flip, drain. Lando, Qui, Obi, and Chewie are supposed to hold the SPort db, and with Fallen Portal you should probably be able to do it. If you get DaRF and BTank set up, you can lose a ship and matching pilot and get them both back! The rest, I suppose, is self-explanatory.
